grammar.summary: 本课学习 keep doing 复现与 go on doing 表持续。

points.title: keep doing / go on doing
points.explanation: He kept on asking questions. keep (on) doing = 不停做；go on doing = 继续做（同一件事）。

examples.en: He went on explaining his policies.

points.title: now that 表"既然"
points.explanation: Now that the election is over... now that = 既然，原因状语从句引导词。

examples.en: Now that it is over, he can relax.
examples.cn: 既然结束了，他可以放松了。
